title: Ladakh: Protesters march in Kargil expressing solidarity with LAB leadership

ai.summary: Ladakh protesters marched in Kargil to support LAB's demand for postponing December 4 hill council elections, citing harsh winter and seasonal migration. Police placed activist Sonam Wangchuk under house arrest after removing him from a Leh protest.

facts.claim: Ladakh MP Hanifa Jan led a march in Kargil to express solidarity with the Leh Apex Body (LAB) over their demand for deferment of December 4 hill council elections
facts.quote: Kargil, Nov 14 (PTI) Ladakh MP Hanifa Jan, along with leaders of the Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA), led a march here to express solidarity with the Leh Apex Body (LAB), including its member Sonam Wangchuk, over their demand for the deferment of the December 4 hill council elections.

facts.claim: Activist Sonam Wangchuk was placed under house arrest after police removed him from a protest site in Leh
facts.quote: A day after police removed activist Wangchuk from a protest site in Leh and escorted him to his residence, the activist on Thursday claimed that he had been placed under house arrest.

facts.claim: LAB and KDA cite harsh winter conditions and large-scale seasonal migration as reasons for demanding postponement of December 4 hill council elections
facts.quote: LAB and KDA have expressed resentment over the holding of hill council elections on December 4, citing harsh winter conditions and large-scale seasonal migration.

ai.background_note: LAB and KDA have been advocating for Ladakh statehood for years, with the current protest demanding postponement of elections due to winter conditions and migration patterns.
